title: Align Cuspy CUPTI stubs and dependencies with CUDA binary builds
body:
Align Cuspy CUPTI stubs and dependencies with CUDA binary builds

CUPTI header discovery skipped the CUDA toolkit, so CUDA 13.4 wheels used
the staged 13.3 headers and lacked source graph IDs even with a 13.4 runtime.
Prefer sufficiently new toolkit headers while preserving explicit overrides
and the staged/wheel fallbacks. This uses the headers already in the builder
images instead of changing the shared Docker header pin.

Export the stub generation API version and compare it with the loaded CUPTI
library. Reject a different major version, including through the observer's
availability fallback; warn on an older runtime within the same major and
accept equal or newer versions within that major.

CUDA 13.4 binary wheels now depend on cupti-python 13.4.0 so Cuspy's Python
bindings are installed with torch. Exclude Python 3.15 and free-threaded
interpreters, for which matching cupti-python wheels are unavailable, and
regenerate the Linux x86_64 and aarch64 workflows.

Test Plan:

```bash
python test/profiler/test_cupti_python.py
PYTHONPATH=. python agent_space/check_cuspy_header_discovery.py
PYTHONPATH=. python agent_space/check_cupti_binary_dependencies.py
python -m pip install --dry-run --ignore-installed --only-binary=:all: 'cupti-python==13.4.0' 'nvidia-cuda-cupti==13.4.58' 'cuda-bindings>=13.0.3,<14'
spin regenerate-github-workflows
lintrunner -a
git diff --check
```

All 12 wrapper tests passed, including major-version errors propagating
through observers. Local scratch checks covered 8 header-discovery cases
and 48 binary dependency configurations. Dependency resolution and lint
passed. The scratch checks are not committed.

```bash
BUILD_IGNORE_SVE_UNAVAILABLE=1 CC=gcc pip install -e . -v --no-build-isolation
```

The editable-build configure step regenerated the 13.4 stubs. The ensuing
native rebuild was interrupted; the generated Python module was refreshed
in the editable installation for the tests above. No full binary build was
completed.

Authored with assistance from an AI coding agent (Codex).
